sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球知名的大学，致力于解决当今世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境方面最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州及全球各地合作创新，寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这全都是该大学旨在提升所有生物生活质量的使命的一部分。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.ucDavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 了解更多信息请访问 21stCentury.ucDavis.edu。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: That's Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: And this is Stephanie Fu.
sentences.zh: 我是斯蒂芬妮·傅。

sentences.en: The palazzo and seating area of this building are provided and maintained for the enjoyment of the public from 8 a.m.
sentences.zh: 这座建筑的柱廊和休息区是为了让公众从早上8点

sentences.en: to 6 p.m.
sentences.zh: 到下午6点能够享受而提供和维护的。

sentences.en: Privately owned public open space.
sentences.zh: 私人拥有的公共开放空间。

sentences.en: Popos.
sentences.zh: 警察。

sentences.en: P-O-P-O-S.
sentences.zh: P-O-P-O-S。

sentences.en: And it has this logo that says public open space and it's kind of this little like tree that's shaped like a house.
sentences.zh: 它有一个标志写着公共开放空间，有点像一棵形状像房子的树。

sentences.en: And all of them have the same logo.
sentences.zh: 所有这些地方都有相同的标志。

sentences.en: The city requires that logo to be on there.
sentences.zh: 城市要求必须贴上那个标志。

sentences.en: It's a cool logo.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很酷的标志。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Pretty small sign though.
sentences.zh: 不过标志挺小的。

sentences.en: My name's Blaine Merker.
sentences.zh: 我叫布莱恩·默克尔。

sentences.en: I'm an artist and part of a group of artists and designers called Rebar.
sentences.zh: 我是一名艺术家，也是一个名为 Rebar 的艺术家和设计师团体的一员。

sentences.en: We're based in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 我们的总部设在旧金山。

sentences.en: Popo.
sentences.zh: 警察。

sentences.en: They're a kind of unique set of spaces that were required to be provided by the developer as a condition of approval for the developer's building.
sentences.zh: 它们是一类独特的空间，是开发商在获准建造大楼时被要求必须提供的。

sentences.en: So the Popos are on private property.
sentences.zh: 所以 Popos 位于私人财产上。

sentences.en: They're owned most likely by the owner of the building.
sentences.zh: 它们很可能属于建筑的所有者。

sentences.en: They look like public space.
sentences.zh: 它们看起来像是公共空间。

sentences.en: They feel like public space for the most part.
sentences.zh: 在很大程度上，它们给人的感觉就像公共空间。

sentences.en: This one that we're standing in is granite walkways and the fountain and grass.
sentences.zh: 我们现在站着的这个地方有花岗岩步道、喷泉和草坪。

sentences.en: But technically speaking, these are totally privately owned.
sentences.zh: 但严格来说，这些完全是私人拥有的。

sentences.en: The only catch is that the developer is legally obliged to make this open to the public and to allow anyone to use it.
sentences.zh: 唯一的条件是，开发商在法律上有义务向公众开放这里，并允许任何人使用。

sentences.en: And no one's quite sure what's allowed here, who's in charge, and what the codes of behavior should be.
sentences.zh: 没有人确切知道这里允许做什么、谁在负责，以及行为准则应该是什么。

sentences.en: And just because they're public doesn't mean they're easy to find.
sentences.zh: 而且，它们是公共的并不意味着它们很容易找到。

sentences.en: So this is sort of a strange environment to walk through to get to a public space.
sentences.zh: 所以走过这样一种环境去寻找一个公共空间，感觉有点奇怪。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: It's got nice art, though.
sentences.zh: 不过这里的艺术品挺好看的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: 536 missions.
sentences.zh: 使命街536号。

sentences.en: It feels like walking into a library.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像走进了一座图书馆。

sentences.en: You'll see, when we walk through security, there'll be this moment where you're like,
sentences.zh: 你会发现，当我们通过安检时，会有那么一个瞬间，让你觉得，

sentences.en: okay, I just crossed a threshold.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我刚刚跨过了一个门槛。

sentences.en: Making eye contact with people in authority and sort of acknowledging them,
sentences.zh: 与掌权者进行眼神交流并向他们示意，

sentences.en: that's not something I ever feel in a park, right?
sentences.zh: 这可不是我在公园里会有的感觉，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, I don't walk into Dolores Park and have to nod to somebody like, yes, it's okay that I'm here.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我走进多洛雷斯公园时，不需要向任何人点头致意，仿佛在说，是的，我在这里是合情合理的。

sentences.en: There's cameras.
sentences.zh: 这里有摄像头。

sentences.en: One, two, three cameras in here.
sentences.zh: 这里有一、二、三个摄像头。

sentences.en: You want to try some badminton?
sentences.zh: 你想试试羽毛球吗？

sentences.en: In here?
sentences.zh: 在这里？

sentences.en: Yeah, why not?
sentences.zh: 对啊，为什么不呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 行。

sentences.en: Yeah, let's do it.
sentences.zh: 走吧，我们来打。

sentences.en: There's a whole set of invisible codes and regulations that shape our behavior.
sentences.zh: 有一整套无形的准则和规章在塑造着我们的行为。

sentences.en: Most of us aren't really consciously aware of them.
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人并没有真正清醒地意识到它们。

sentences.en: How you hold yourself in public, where you think you can sit down, who you can talk to.
sentences.zh: 你在公共场合的仪态、你觉得可以坐哪儿、你可以跟谁说话。

sentences.en: It's only by doing something that pushed back against those codes that you actually can see the codes.
sentences.zh: 只有当你做出一些挑战这些准则的事情时，你才能真正看到这些准则。

sentences.en: Sort of like a scientist firing an electron at an atom to see where it is.
sentences.zh: 就像科学家向原子发射电子来观察它的位置一样。

sentences.en: If you fire an electron at an atom, you actually change the course of the atom.
sentences.zh: 如果你向原子发射电子，你实际上就改变了原子的轨迹。

sentences.en: When you're in one of these spaces, when you start to push back against the codes of behavior,
sentences.zh: 当你身处这些空间之一，当你开始挑战行为准则时，

sentences.en: you actually change the codes of behavior while you do that.
sentences.zh: 你在这样做的同时也改变了行为准则。

sentences.en: And nothing happened.
sentences.zh: 结果什么也没发生。

sentences.en: Nothing happened.
sentences.zh: 什么也没发生。

sentences.en: I was just like, all right.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，好吧。

sentences.en: We definitely played long enough probably to be noticed on camera, right?
sentences.zh: 我们绝对玩了足够长的时间，可能在监控里都被注意到了吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And nobody came.
sentences.zh: 而且没有人来。

sentences.en: Nobody came.
sentences.zh: 没有人来。

sentences.en: Score one for public space.
sentences.zh: 公共空间得胜一局。

sentences.en: But if you really want to test the tolerance of a privately owned public open space,
sentences.zh: 但如果你真的想测试一个私人拥有的公共开放空间的包容度，

sentences.en: badminton may not be the best teSt.
sentences.zh: 打羽毛球可能并不是最好的测试方式。

sentences.en: I mean, if you really want to make someone in authority uncomfortable,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果你真的想让掌权者感到不自在，

sentences.en: the most subversive act, especially right now, may be doing nothing at all.
sentences.zh: 最具颠覆性的行为，尤其是在现在，可能就是什么也不做。

sentences.en: There's a few behaviors that you can sort of plausibly do that allow you to be idle,
sentences.zh: 有一些行为你可以看似合理地去做，让你能够无所事事，

sentences.en: like fiddling with your phone or smoking or reading a book.
sentences.zh: 比如摆弄手机、抽烟或看书。

sentences.en: But to just like lie down and do nothing, not okay.
sentences.zh: 但如果只是躺下来什么也不做，那就不行了。

sentences.en: It draws attention to do nothing.
sentences.zh: 什么都不做会引起注意。

sentences.en: The San Francisco Planning and Urban Research Association, which is better known as SPUR,
sentences.zh: 旧金山规划与城市研究协会（更广为人知的名字是 SPUR）

sentences.en: has a great guide to all the popos in the city and recommendations about how to improve current
sentences.zh: 有一份极佳的指南，涵盖了市内所有的 popos，并提出了关于如何改善现有和未来 popos 的建议，

sentences.en: and future popos, including a proposal to codify some of these rules for the social aspects of
sentences.zh: 其中包括一项提案，即为私人拥有的公共开放空间的社会层面确立其中一些规则。

sentences.en: privately owned public open spaces.
sentences.zh: 私人拥有的公共开放空间。

sentences.en: I think it's key to keep in mind that popos will never fully supplant the need for a true
sentences.zh: 我认为关键是要记住，popos 永远无法完全取代城市中对真正的公共空间的真正需求。

sentences.en: comments for true public spaces in a city.
sentences.zh: 公共空间。

sentences.en: Popos can be these great hidden gems in the nooks and crannies of a city,
sentences.zh: Popos 可以是城市角落里极好的隐秘瑰宝，

sentences.en: but even if you're allowed to play badminton, the fact that you have to test for it means
sentences.zh: 但即使你被允许打羽毛球，你必须去测试这一事实也意味着这些空间并不真正属于我们。

sentences.en: these spaces aren't really ours.
sentences.zh: 这些空间并不是真正属于我们的。
